statement: RMR-FORENSIC-TIME-V1 uses RFC3339 UTC with Z plus Unix epoch seconds as the canonical instant representation.
falsifier: The validator accepts a record whose UTC timestamp and epoch identify different seconds.

statement: A local civil timestamp is admissible only with an explicit numeric UTC offset and must resolve to the same instant as the canonical UTC timestamp.
falsifier: A local timestamp without offset or with a mismatching instant is accepted.

statement: Daylight-saving policy changes the local civil offset/context, not the canonical UTC instant.
falsifier: The profile changes canonical UTC solely because a local DST rule changes.

statement: The instant digest excludes local timezone and DST context, while the local attestation digest includes them; therefore the same instant can retain one universal identity while preserving distinct local forensic contexts.
falsifier: Changing only a valid local representation changes the instant digest or fails to change the local attestation digest.

statement: The Custody16 core remains clock-free; temporal evidence is attached outside the deterministic core and bound to the evidence digest.
falsifier: The implementation requires a timezone/DST clock inside the deterministic Custody16 snapshot core.

statement: A local attestation digest is an integrity seal for the time record, not a digital signature and not a trusted external timestamp.
falsifier: The profile promotes a bare digest to signer authentication or trusted time authority evidence.

statement: A detached signature can bind a key identity to the local attestation preimage, but clock correctness requires separate clock evidence and external trusted time remains a distinct gate.
falsifier: The profile claims a valid signature alone proves clock synchronization or external timestamp authority.

statement: No RFC3161/TSA receipt or scheme-specific digital signature is materialized by this profile revision.
falsifier: A verifiable signature or trusted timestamp receipt with preserved verifier evidence is added.
